'''Izzar''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Izzar and two other Jawas, [[Hadiir]] and [[Mnek]], worked as scrap merchants during the conflict, traveling [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and offering a wide variety of valuable items.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hadiir, Izzar, and Mnek were first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds|''Galactic Strongholds'']], which was released in [[2014]]. The three Scrap Vendors allow players to acquire crafting materials relatively easily in exchange for Jawa Scrap, which is awarded through the Conquest system and from the Cartel Market. Izzar accepts the "Jawa Junk" currency for "Artifact Materials," the rare purple-level crafting materials. The trio can be found on either faction's Fleet in the Cartel Bazaar, and are also available as decorations for Strongholds.<ref name="TOR" />
